consequence.statement: A new optional schema field is now available for Azure DNS managed identity in Issuers; existing Issuers keep working without changes.

assertion.statement: The cert-manager.io/v1 Issuer schema gains a new field, spec.acme.solvers[].dns01.azureDNS.managedIdentity.tenantID; it is additive and existing Issuers are not affected.
